title: CymbalMart Shopping Agent
summary: An AI shopping assistant that turns natural-language event needs into personalised, budget-conscious product suggestions and curated carts.
highlights: Converts free-text event requirements into a curated, budget-aware cart.
Uses Gemini through Google AI Studio for reasoning and recommendations.
React and TypeScript interface built around a conversational shopping flow.

title: Green Route Travel Recommendation System
summary: A route recommendation experience with a machine-learning model comparison and Dijkstra-based route optimisation, presented through an interactive Streamlit interface.
highlights: Compares machine-learning approaches for route recommendations.
Uses Dijkstra-based optimisation to produce practical routes.
Interactive Streamlit interface for exploring recommendations.

title: Visual Search + OCR Comparison
summary: A browser-based visual search application comparing Tesseract.js and TrOCR, with object detection, text extraction and OCR evaluation tools.
highlights: Compares Tesseract.js and TrOCR for text extraction.
Combines visual search with object detection and OCR evaluation.
Browser-based workflow built with Next.js and TypeScript.

title: Smart Waste Management OpenEnv
summary: A simulated municipal complaint-resolution environment where an AI agent classifies waste complaints, assigns departments, dispatches trucks and completes cleanup through a staged API workflow.
highlights: Models a municipal complaint-resolution workflow as a simulated environment.
AI agent classifies complaints, assigns departments and dispatches cleanup.
FastAPI-based staged workflow with OpenEnv and Hugging Face deployment.

title: Emergency Message Prioritization System
summary: A human-in-the-loop decision-support prototype that combines classical NLP with a reinforcement-learning queue simulator and a transparent rule-based baseline.
highlights: Combines classical NLP with a reinforcement-learning queue simulator.
Includes a transparent rule-based baseline for comparison.
Human-in-the-loop design that never dispatches emergency services autonomously.

title: Community Resource Sharing System
summary: A platform connecting people who want to donate or request unused household items, with a Spring Boot backend and Streamlit interface.
highlights: Connects donors and requesters of unused household items.
Spring Boot backend with a Streamlit interface.
Stores listings and requests in SQLite.

title: AQI Prediction System
summary: A Flask application that predicts AQI from pollutant measurements, supported by data preprocessing, exploratory analysis, model training and evaluation.
highlights: Predicts AQI from pollutant measurements.
Covers preprocessing, exploratory analysis, model training and evaluation.
Flask application for presenting predictions.
